prose:
CNBC reports a Wednesday Asian technology selloff after renewed US AI-linked equity declines. The accessed update shows SoftBank down 15%, Advantest around 13%, Tokyo Electron about 12.8% and major Korean memory names more than 8%, while some Hong Kong-listed Chinese technology shares move against the trend.

The values are an evolving session snapshot, not closing prices, and differ from earlier feed percentages as the report updates. Explanations about capital spending, energy and future memory shortages are attributed analyst views rather than proven causes or forecasts. Semiconductor subsectors and countries do not move identically, and no investment conclusion follows automatically.
highlights: Accessed values differ from an earlier feed snapshot
Some Hong Kong names buck the wider decline
Analyst links weakness to AI-spending sustainability concerns
No closing price or future return is established
